title: The Holy Prophet’s (saw) Prayer
method: Offer a two-unit prayer reciting in each unit Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Qadr fifteen times. In Ruku`, recite Surah al-Qadr fifteen times. After Ruku`, fifteen times. In first Sujud, fifteen times. After first Sujud, fifteen times. In second Sujud, fifteen times. After second Sujud, fifteen times.

lines.english: There is no god save Allah;
our Lord and the Lord of our fathers of old.
There is no god save Allah;

lines.transliteration: ilahan wahidan wa nahnu lahu muslimuna
lines.english: one God, and to Him are we submissive.
There is no god save Allah;
we worship none save Him,
making our devotion sincere as in His sight
even though the polytheists may detest it.
There is no god save Allah;
alone, alone, alone,
He has truly fulfilled His promise,
granted His servant victory,
made powerful His soldiers,
and defeated the parties alone.
All sovereignty be His and all praise be to Him.
And He has power over all things.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ
lines.transliteration: allahumma anta nuru alssamawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna
lines.english: O Allah, You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in these two.
So, all praise be to You.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ قَيَّامُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فيهِنَّ
lines.transliteration: wa anta qayyamu alssamawati wal-ardi wa man fihinna
lines.english: And You are the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth and whatever exists in these two.
So, all praise be to You.
You are the (utter) Truth,
Your promise is utterly true,
Your word is true,
Your fulfillment is true,
Paradise is true,
and Hellfire is true.
O Allah, to You have I surrendered,
in You do I believe,
on You do I rely,
for Your sake do I dispute,
and Your judgment do I seek.

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا ربِّ
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi
lines.english: O my Lord; O my Lord; O my Lord;

lines.transliteration: ighfir li ma qaddamtu wa akhkhartu
lines.english: (please) forgive me my past and next sins
and my hidden and open ones.

lines.arabic: أَنْتَ إِلٰهِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: anta ilahi la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: You are verily my God; there is no god save You.
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive me,
have mercy on me,
and accept my repentance.
Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Merciful.

sections.title: First Prayer of Lady Fatimah (sa)
sections.method: Offer a two-unit prayer. In the first unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Qadr one hundred times. In the second unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Tawhid (Ikhlas) one hundred times. On accomplishment, say the following supplication.

lines.english: O My God and Master,
whilst one prepares oneself, sets up,
arranges, or gets ready
for visiting a mortal
in the hope of attaining a gift, interests,

lines.transliteration: wa na'ilihi wa fawadilihi wa jawa'izihi
lines.english: a souvenir, bequests, or presents from him,

lines.transliteration: fa-ilayka ya ilahi kanat tahyi'ati wa ta`bi'ati
lines.english: to You, O my God, have I prepared myself, set up,
arranged and got ready
in the hope of attaining Your interests, favors,
souvenirs, and presents.
Hence, (please) do not disappoint me of all these.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ مَسْأَلَةُ ٱلسَّائِلِ
lines.transliteration: ya man la takhibu `alayhi mas'alatu alssa'ili
lines.english: O You with Whom no asker is disappointed
and no present of an earner causes You reduction.

lines.arabic: فَإنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ بعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ قَدَّمْتُهُ
lines.transliteration: fa'inni lam atika bi`amalin salihin qaddamtuhu
lines.english: In fact, I have not come to You with a righteous deed that I have done
nor with an intercession of a creature that I hope
to seek Your nearness through him
save Muhammad and his Household,
Your blessings be upon him and them.
I am coming to You hoping for Your munificent amnesty
that You have conferred upon the sinners
at their committed commitment to forbidden acts;

lines.arabic: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَحَارِمِ
lines.english: nevertheless, their long-lasting commitment to forbidden acts has not made You
stop conferring upon them with Your forgiveness.
You, O my Master, always confer upon me with Your graces
while I always recommit sins.

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
lines.english: I thus ask You by the Right of Muhammad and his Household, the Immaculate,
to forgive my grand sins,

lines.arabic: فَإنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلْعَظِيمَ إِلاَّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
lines.transliteration: fa'innahu la yaghfiru al`azima illa al`azimu
lines.english: for none forgives the grand sins but the All-great.

lines.arabic: يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
lines.english: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great,

lines.arabic: يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
lines.english: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great,
O All-great!

sections.title: Another Prayer of Lady Fatimah (sa)
sections.method: Offer a four-unit prayer (two by two). In the first unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Tawhid fifty times. In the second, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-`Adiyat fifty times. In the third, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Zalzalah fifty times. In the fourth, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Nasr fifty times. On accomplishment, say the following supplication.

lines.english: O Allah, I seek nearness to You through Your remembrance,
I seek Your intercession with Yourself,

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَنْ تُدْنِيَنِي مِنْ قُرْبِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bijudika an tudniyani min qurbika
lines.english: I ask You by Your bounty to bring me near to Your proximity,
to grant me gratitude to You,
and to inspire me with Your remembrance.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka su'ala khadi`in mutadhallilin khashi`in
lines.english: O Allah, I ask You as a submissive, humble and lowly asker
to forgive me, have mercy on me,
and make me satisfied and contented with Your distribution
and humble in all circumstances.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ ٱشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa as'aluka su'ala man ishtaddat faqatuhu
lines.english: O Allah, I ask You as one whose indigence is extreme
and who has stated his need to You in hardships
and whose desire for what is with You is great.

sections.title: A Third Prayer of Lady Fatimah (sa)
sections.method: Offer a two-unit prayer. In each unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and repeat Surah al-Ikhlas (al-Tawhid) sixty times. On accomplishment, say the following supplication.

lines.english: Glory be to the Lord of lofty, sublime Honor.
Glory be to the Lord of Magnificent, Great Majesty.
Glory be to the Lord of ancient, excellent Sovereignty.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرَىٰ أَثَرَ ٱلنَّمْلَةِ فِي ٱلصَّفَا
lines.transliteration: subhana man yara atharan namlati fis safa
lines.english: Glory be to Him Who sees the footprints of an ant on a smooth stone.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرَىٰ وَقْعَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فِي ٱلْهَوَاءِ
lines.transliteration: subhana man yara waq`at tayri fil hawa
lines.english: Glory be to Him Who sees the path of a bird in the air.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هٰكَذَا وَلاَ هٰكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
lines.transliteration: subhana man huwa hakadha wa la hakadha ghayruhu
lines.english: Glory be to Him Who is exactly so and none other than Him is so.

title: Imam Ali’s (as) Prayer
method: Offer a four-unit prayer. In each unit, recite Surah al-Fatihah once and Surah al-Tawhid fifty times.

lines.english: Glory be to Him Whose signs never perish.
Glory be to Him Whose reserves never downgrade.
Glory be to Him Whose honor never vanishes.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْفَدُ مَا عِنْدَهُ
lines.english: Glory be to Him Whose possessions never run out.
Glory be to Him Whose duration (of existence) is never interrupted.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لاَ يُشَارِكُ أَحَداً فِي أَمْرِهِ
lines.transliteration: subhana man la yushariku ahadan fi amrihi
lines.english: Glory be to Him Who never betakes to Himself a partner in His affairs.
Glory be to Him save Whom there is no god.

title: Imam al-Hasan’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of four units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Tawhid is repeated twenty-five times.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni ataqarrabu ilayka bijudika wa karamika
lines.english: O Allah, I seek nearness to You in the name of Your magnanimity and nobility.

lines.transliteration: wa ataqarrabu ilayka bimuhammadin `abdika wa rasulika
lines.english: I seek nearness to You in the name of Muhammad, Your servant and messenger.
I seek nearness to You in the name of Your Favorite Angels
and Your prophets and messengers,
[and I beseech You] to send blessings to Muhammad,
Your servant and messenger,
and upon the Household of Muhammad,
overlook my slips,
cover my sins,
forgive them for me,
settle all my needs,

lines.transliteration: wa la tu`adhdhibni biqabihin kana minni
lines.english: and not to punish me for the evildoings that I have committed.
Verily, Your pardon and magnanimity include me.
Verily, You have power over all things.

title: Imam al-Husayn’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of four units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah and Surah al-Tawhid are repeated twenty-five times. While genuflecting, Surah al-Fatihah and Surah al-Tawhid are repeated ten times. So is done when one raises his head after the genuflection and while prostrating oneself and between the two prostrations. On accomplishment, the following supplicatory prayer is said.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الَّذِي ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لآِدَمَ وَحَوَّاءَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma anta alladhi istajabta li-adama wa hawwa'a
lines.english: O Allah, it is You who responded to Adam and Eve

title: Imam Zayn al-`Abidin’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of four units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once while Surah al-Tawhid is repeated one hundred times.

lines.english: O He Who has shown only goodness
and concealed the evil (deeds of His servants)!
O He Who has not censured for the offenses
and has not exposed the hidden!
O He Who is Ample in pardoning!
O He Who is Excellent in overlooking!
O He Who is Liberal in forgiving!
O He Who opens His hands wide with mercy!
O He Who is present in all confidential talks!
O He Who is the ultimate objective of all complaints!
O He Who is Generous in condonation!
O He Who is greatly hoped!
O He Who takes the initiative in favoring before they are deserved!

lines.transliteration: ya rabbana wa sayyidana wa mawlana
lines.english: O our Lord, our Master, and our Chief!
O He Who is the ultimate of our desires!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka allahumma an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: I beseech You, O Allah, to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-Baqir’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and the following litany is repeated one hundred times: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: All glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
and Allah is the Greatest.
O Allah, I beseech You,
O Indulgent, Forbearing,
Forgiving, and Loving-kind,

lines.arabic: أَنْ تَتَجَاوَزَ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِي وَمَا عِنْدِي
lines.english: to overlook my sins and what I have had,
out of the excellence of what You have,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي مِنْ عَطَائِكَ مَا يَسَعُنِي
lines.transliteration: wa an tu`tiyani min `ata'ika ma yasa`uni
lines.english: to give me, out of Your giving, that which suffices me,

lines.transliteration: wa tulhimani fima a`taytani al`amala fihi
lines.english: to inspire me to act upon what You have given me;
that is to obey You and to obey Your Messenger,
and to give me part of Your pardon
so much so that I ought to have Your honoring.
O Allah, (please) grant me that which befits You

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa la taf`al bi ma ana ahluhu
lines.english: and do not do to me that which I deserve.
Verily, I exist through You

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلاَّ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa lam usib khayran qattu illa minka
lines.english: and I have never been given any good thing from any source except You.
O He Who is the best Seer of all those who can see!
O He Who is the best Hearer of all those who can hear!
O He Who is the Justest of all those who judge!
O He Who aids those who seek His aid!
O He Who responds to the prayer of the oppressed!
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-Sadiq’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Ayat al-Shahadah (3:18-19) one hundred times. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: O He Who Makes all made things!
O He Who splints all broken bones!
O He Who is present in all assemblages!
O He Who is the Witness of all confidential talks!
O He Who knows all hidden matters!
O He Who is always present and is never absent!
O He Who is always triumphant and is never defeated!
O He Who is always nigh and is never remote!
O He Who entertains all lonely ones!
O He Who is ever-living, raiser of the dead,
and causing the alive to die!

lines.arabic: ٱلْقَائِمُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
lines.english: O He Who watches every soul as to what it earns!

lines.transliteration: wa ya hayyan hina la hayya
lines.english: O He Who was living when there was nothing existent!
There is no god save You!
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-Kazim’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Tawhid is repeated twelve times. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: O my God, all sounds are submissive to You,
all intellects are too short to recognize You [as exactly as You are],
all things are fearful of You,
all things flee to You,
all things are too tiny in comparison with You,
and Your light fills all things.
Therefore, You are the Exalted in Your majesty,
You are the Luminous in Your splendor,
You are the Great in Your omnipotence,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alladhi la ya'uduka shay'un
lines.english: and You are Whom nothing can tire.
O He Who sends down my bounties!
O He Who relieves my agonies!
O He Who settles my needs!
(please) Give answer to my request,
in the name of ‘There is no god save You’.
I believe in You and I am sincere to You in obedience.

lines.arabic: أَصْبَحْتُ عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ
lines.english: I begin my day keeping my covenant and promise to You as much as I can.
I confess of Your favor to me

lines.arabic: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنَ ٱلذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي لاَ يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa astaghfiruka mina aldhdhunubi allati la yaghfiruha ghayruka
lines.english: and I beseech You to forgive my sins that none else can forgive.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ دَانٍ
lines.english: O He Who is nigh in His sublimity,
Sublime in His nearness,
Brilliant in His glow,
and Powerful in His [absolute] authority!
(please) Send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household.

title: Imam ali-Rida’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of six units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Insan (or al-Dahr No. 76) is repeated ten times. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: O My Companion in my distress!
O My Patron in my bounties!

lines.transliteration: wa ya ilahi wa ilaha ibrahima wa isma`ila
lines.english: O My God and the God of Abraham, Ishmael,
Isaac, and Jacob!

lines.arabic: يَا رَبَّ كٰهٰيٰعصٰ وَيٰس وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
lines.transliteration: ya rabba kaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad wa ya-sin walqur'ani alhakimi
lines.english: O Lord of kaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad, ya'-sin, and the Qur'an full of wisdom!
I beseech You—O Most Excellent of all those who may be besought!
O Most Favorite of all those who may be prayed!
O Most Magnanimous of all those who may give!
O Most Preferred of all those who may be hoped!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-Jawad’s(as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Tawhid is repeated seventy times. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: O Allah, Lord of the souls passing away
and the rotten corpses!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ ٱلأَرْوَاحِ ٱلرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَىٰ أَجْسَادِهَا
lines.transliteration: as'aluka bita`ati al-arwahi alrraji`ati ila ajsadiha
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of the obedience of the souls that are restored to their bodies
and the obedience of the corpses that join their veins
and in the name of Your Word that is effective on them
and in the name of Your judging justly among them;
while the [other] creatures are standing before You
awaiting the decisions of Your judgment,
hoping for Your mercy, and fearing Your punishment;
(please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
place light in my sight,
strong belief in my heart,
and reference to You night and day on my tongue,
and provide me with a righteous deed.

title: Imam al-Hadi’s(as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in the first of which Surahs al-Fatihah and Yasin (No. 36) are recited and in the second of which Surahs al-Fatihah and al-Rahman (No. 55) are recited. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.english: O Foremost Beneficent! O Object of Love!
O He Who is the Witness of all unseen things!
O He Who is Nigh without being away (from any other thing)!
O He Who (always) prevails (but) is never overpowered!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man la ya`lamu kayfa huwa illa huwa
lines.english: O He Whom no one knows how He is except He!
O He Whose authority no one can challenge!
I beseech You, O Allah, in Your name: the Well-Guarded, the Treasured,
the Concealed from whom You will,
the Pure, the Purified, the Holy,
the utter Light,
the Ever-living, the Everlasting, the Greatest,
the Light of the heavens and the Light of the [layers of the] earth,
the Knower of the unseen and the seen
the Highest, the Sublime, the Glorious!
Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-`Askari’s (as) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of four units in the first two of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Zalzalah (No. 99) is repeated fifteen times, and the last two of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once and Surah al-Tawhid is repeated fifteen times. Then the following supplication is said.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi-anna laka alhamda
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of all praise being to You;
there is no god save You,
[You are] the Premier before all things;
and You are the Ever-living, the Self-Subsistent;
and there is no god save You,
nothing can humiliate You;

lines.transliteration: wa anta kulla yawmin fi sha'nin
lines.english: and You, every moment, are in a state (of glory).
There is no god save You,

lines.arabic: خَالِقُ مَا يُرَىٰ وَمَا لاَ يُرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: khaliqu ma yura wa ma la yura
lines.english: the Creator of what is seen and what cannot be seen,
the Knower of all things without learning;
I beseech You in the name of Your bounties and gratuities
and in the name of Your being Allah, the One Lord,
there is no god save You,
the All-beneficent, the All-merciful;
and I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah;
there is no god save You,
the Unique, the Single,
the One, and the eternally Besought of all,

lines.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
lines.english: Who begets not, nor is he begotten,

lines.transliteration: wa lang yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun
lines.english: and none is like Him.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
there is no god save You;
the Knower of subtleties, the All-aware,

lines.arabic: ٱلْقَائِمُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
lines.english: Who watches every soul as to what it earns,
the Watcher, the Preserver.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
the First before all things,
the Last after all things,
the Knower of all hidden things,
the source of both harm [for those who deserve harm] and benefit,
the All-wise, and All-knowing.
And I beseech You in the name of Your being Allah,
there is no god save You,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsistent,
the Resurrector, the Inheritor,
the All-tender, the All-favorer,
the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth,
the Lord of majesty and honor,

lines.arabic: وَذُو ٱلطَّوْلِ وَذُو ٱلْعِزَّةِ وَذُو ٱلسُّلْطَانِ
lines.transliteration: wa dhulttawli wa dhul`izzati wa dhulssultani
lines.english: and the Lord of bounty, dignity, and absolute authority.
There is no god save You;
You encompass all things with knowledge,
and You record the number of all things;
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

title: Imam al-Mahdi’s (ajtfs) Prayer on Fridays
method: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Fatihah is recited once but the verse 'iyyaka na`budu wa-iyyaka nasta`in' is repeated one hundred times. Then, Surah al-Tawhid is recited once. Finally, the following supplication is said.

lines.english: You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.
O Allah, unbearable is our tribulation!
The hidden has been disclosed!
The cover has been exposed!

lines.transliteration: wa daqat al-ardu bima wasa`at alssama'u
lines.english: The earth has become too narrow to carry that which could be embraced by the sky.
To You, my Lord, is the complaint
and in You is the trust in sorrow and in joy.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
whom You have commanded us to obey,
and hasten their Relief through the Rising Imam among them;
and make manifest Your fortifying him.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Save me, for you both are true saviors of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Aid me, for you both are true aides of me.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Protect me, for you both are true protectors of me.
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
Help, help, help!
[come to] succor me, [come to] succor me, [come to] succor me!
[grant me] security, [grant me] security, [grant me] security!
